build.native: Both Rust SDKs use Bazel -c opt and SDK-scoped cross-crate ThinLTO; both C++ consumers Release -O3.
build.comparator: Pinned upstream release, opt-level=z, full LTO, one codegen unit. Bootstrap/workloads compiled with Hermes -O.
build.clock: Same high-resolution steady_clock __now() hook; full TS suite also uses __now().

benchmarkScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
bootstrap="$PWD/$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-plural-magrinj-bytecode-path)"
run_variant() {
 case "$1" in
  before) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-locale-inline-hires "$2" ;;
  after) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires "$2" ;;
  magrinj) FORMATJS_BENCH_BOOTSTRAP="$bootstrap" taskset -c 0 /tmp/hi-host-optimized "$2" ;;
 esac
}
run_case() {
 local label="$1" workload="$2"
 for variant in $variants; do
  run_variant "$variant" "$workload" > "/tmp/hermes-plural-record-${label:+$label-}$variant-$round.jsonl"
 done
}
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case '' /tmp/hermes-list-default-overlap.hbc
 run_case tag /tmp/hermes-canonical-control.hbc
 run_case size /tmp/hermes-list-size-control.hbc
 run_case locale /tmp/hermes-canonical-locale-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case constructor /tmp/hermes-list-constructor-control.hbc
 run_case relative /tmp/hermes-rtf-bridge-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='after before'; else variants='before after'; fi
 run_case full /tmp/hermes-locale-inline-all-api.hbc
done

for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case boundary /tmp/hermes-list-short-boundary-control.js
done

for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='after before'; else variants='before after'; fi
 run_case plural /tmp/hermes-plural-record-control.js
done
profileScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
sdk=/tmp/hermes-extension-sdk-plural-record-hires
host=/tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires
for smoke in "$sdk"/js/*-smoke.js; do
 case "$smoke" in *datetimeformat-smoke.js) "$host" /tmp/hermes-list-default-datetime-smoke.js ;; *) "$host" "$smoke" ;; esac
done
"$host" /tmp/hermes-locale-extension-sdk-check.js > /tmp/hermes-plural-record-sdk-extension-check.json
for variant in before after; do
 if [ "$variant" = before ]; then host=/tmp/hermes-locale-inline-hires; else host=/tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires; fi
 taskset -c 0 "$host" -sample-profiling=chrome -sample-profiling-freq=1000 -profiling-out="/tmp/hermes-plural-record-final-$variant.cpuprofile" /tmp/hermes-plural-options-profile.js > "/tmp/hermes-plural-record-final-$variant-profile.log" 2>&1
 "$host" /tmp/hermes-benchmark-clock-check.js > "/tmp/hermes-plural-record-clock-$variant.json"
done
bash /tmp/hermes-plural-record-run.sh
consumerBuildScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
PATH=/tmp/hermes-tools:$PATH bazel cquery -c opt //native/hermes/package:sdk --output=files > /tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires-sdk-path 2>/tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires-query.log
sdk_dir=/tmp/hermes-extension-sdk-plural-record-hires
mkdir -p "$sdk_dir"
tar -xf "$(cat /tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires-sdk-path)" -C "$sdk_dir"
# SDK tar timestamps are reproducible; refresh archive times for this CMake consumer.
find "$sdk_dir" -name '*.a' -exec touch {} +
find "$sdk_dir/src" -name '*.inc' -exec touch {} +
cp "$sdk_dir"/contrib/[34][0-9]-*.js "$sdk_dir"/contrib/FormatJSIntl.cpp "$sdk_dir"/contrib/FormatJSIntl.h /tmp/hermes-extension-host/API/hermes/extensions/contrib/
cmake -S /tmp/hermes-extension-host -B /tmp/hermes-extension-build -DFORMATJS_HERMES_SDK="$sdk_dir" >/tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires-cmake.log 2>&1
cmake --build /tmp/hermes-extension-build --target hermes -j8 >>/tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires-cmake.log 2>&1
cp /tmp/hermes-extension-build/bin/hermes /tmp/hermes-plural-record-hires
order: Three CPU-0-pinned optimized rounds, before/after/magrinj in rounds 1 and 3 and reverse in round 2. Full 14-case native/TS suite uses the same frozen bytecode on both SDKs, three rounds, reverse in round 2. Source-only boundary and PluralRules constructor controls follow. Profiles finish before timing; no builds/profiles overlap timing.
change: Reuse at most 64 immutable Rust PluralRules handles after locale negotiation and all option getters/coercions. Keys contain resolved locale and complete serialized options; keys over 512 characters bypass reuse. Successful locale loading clears reuse; existing instances keep their selected data. Every constructor still allocates its own receiver and query results stay fresh. Stop scanning the private increment table after a match.
conformance: Thirteen focused gates after record reuse include dependent Duration/Number/RelativeTime suites, Chromium locales, PluralRules Test262 and pinned ICU4C/J formatting plus ICU4X plural comparisons. The final increment-loop refinement reruns PluralRules source/package/Test262. New tests passed before and after reuse: getter/coercion and exception preservation, fresh receivers/results, explicit-options data replacement, and 80 distinct digit combinations while Map intrinsics are poisoned. Rust crate sources and both SDK Rust archives remain identical.
